summary: One custom carrier supports the existing Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32S3, three switches, a MEMS microphone, amplifier and direct plug-in connections for the YouXin TFT and speaker.

required_interfaces.description: Direct 8-pin 2.54 mm socket for the 32 x 43.72 mm display. Centre the entire 27.72 mm square active area inside the bezel and clamp the PCB on its corner lands.
Align the XIAO onboard USB-C receptacle with the existing shell opening for charging and download.
Three direct-acting caps at the marked lower-left triangle. Each stem aligns with its own PCB switch.
Fit the original socketed XIAO ESP32S3 on a single custom carrier with the TFT socket and speaker connector. Verify button axes, battery, antenna and screen clearance.
Provide an open, isolated sound path from the outside to the microphone port.
Retain the rear grille and accommodate the supplied speaker lead and its polarized two-pin plug at SPK1 on the motherboard.

assembly_story.installation: Fit the display in the keyed front bezel and install the keeper against its PCB. Mate the motherboard straight onto the eight screen pins using the housing guides, then secure the board independently. Install the speaker behind the grille, plug its supplied lead into SPK1 and restrain slack. Fit the battery without compression. Check the mic seal, button return and USB plug clearance before closing the four back screws.
assembly_story.maintenance: Remove the back screws to replace the battery.
user_access: split ring at the top star point
